evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 3.3 ppm at growth onset, consistent with the low post-purge baseline.
Oxygen rose to 17.1 ppm during growth.
Oxygen has risen persistently through successive growth observations to 33.2 ppm, indicating loss of the established low-oxygen condition.
Temperature 750.5 °C and argon flow 99.2 sccm track setpoints; pressure remains 760.1 Torr and heater power is stable at 45.4%, without a corresponding thermal, flow, or pressure anomaly.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and a seal/leak check are needed to distinguish air ingress from outgassing or oxygen-sensor error; no sample characterization is available.
